name: double-check
description: Force the AI to double-check its own work — a self-review skill that catches the bugs, holes and hallucinations the AI missed the first time.

plugins.name: double-check
plugins.description: Make the AI rigorously review its own output before you ship: bidirectional reasoning + reverse rebuttal + domain checklists (13/21/18 questions). Catches AI hallucinations and false 'done'. Trigger with 2 / 'double-check' / 'review'.
